title: From Aircraft Carriers to Billboard Charts to Bar Carts - B. Taylor Joins Fifty States Vodka as a Brand Ambassador | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
Las Vegas, Nevada - Fifty States Vodka is proud to announce a landmark partnership with decorated Navy veteran, global ambassador, multi-platinum recording artist, and producer B. Taylor , who joins the brand as national spokesperson and brand ambassador.
This collaboration unites B. Taylor's L1FE Organization mission with Fifty States Vodka's commitment to American values and support for military personnel, veterans, and first responders.
Crafted with precision in Michigan using premium sweet corn harvested from America's heartland, Fifty States Vodka embodies authentic American craftsmanship. The brand's distinctive red, white, and blue packaging reflects its deep-rooted commitment to American values and dedicated support of active-duty military, veterans, first responders, and their families.
"I am excited about the new partnership with Fifty States Vodka and their belief in me to expand this great American brand nationwide," says B. Taylor . "As Veterans, we acquire many skills and attributes during our service, and it's awesome for a company such as Fifty States Vodka to recognize that."
Carl Folkman, COO of Fifty States Vodka: "We are proud to support the men and women who serve and protect our great nation, and we are honored to have such a distinguished brand ambassador as B.Taylor. Our joint efforts represent a cornerstone of our brand identity and strategic vision."
B. Taylor brings an exceptional background to this partnership. His forthcoming release, "We Are One, A Mother's Love" (Country Version), debuts this May and stands as a powerful anthem celebrating America's mothers, liberties, democracy, and resilience. With six number-one hits and two Top 10 records on Billboard and iTunes charts, B. Taylor's message of unity resonates across diverse communities.
His credentials extend beyond music to significant humanitarian work. In recognition of his education initiatives, veteran wellness programs, and military service, B.Taylor was selected by Nelson Mandela and the Mandela Foundation as a co-founding member of the first official Nelson Mandela Signature electric vehicle to be headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona.
He is the first person authorized to use Nelson Mandela's officially authenticated signature, which he received from the Mandela Foundation leadership on July 2nd.
This partnership between Fifty States Vodka and B. Taylor represents more than a business alliance—it embodies a shared vision of American excellence, service, and unity as the brand expands its national footprint under B. Taylor's ambassadorship allows consumers to enjoy premium American-made vodka and the satisfaction of supporting initiatives that honor our military, veterans, and first responders.
